title: Automating Attack Graph Construction for Agentic Pentesting. Towards Neuro-Symbolic Vulnerability Hunting
abstract: arXiv:2609.15523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Logic attack graphs grounded in scanner output provide explicit and auditable attack path reasoning LLM-based agents lack. Integrating symbolic frameworks such as MulVAL to contemporary security workflows or agentic pipelines, however, requires translating scanner evidence to initial facts, and creating domain-specific rules. We present a semi-automated pipeline that addresses this interoperability problem and depict its feasibility in a web-security case study. Our pipeline parses findings from Trivy, Semgrep, and Nmap into MulVAL predicates and uses an LLM-assisted process to construct domain-specific Datalog rules linking scanner-detectable evidence to attack techniques. MulVAL/XSB then performs symbolic inference to generate structured attack paths. translated_title: 面向智能体渗透测试的攻击图自动化构建：迈向神经符号化漏洞挖掘
translated_abstract: 基于扫描器输出的逻辑攻击图能够提供显式且可审计的攻击路径推理能力，而这正是基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体所缺乏的。然而，将MulVAL等符号化框架整合到现代安全工作流或智能体流水线中，需要将扫描器证据转换为初始事实，并创建领域特定规则。我们提出了一种半自动化流水线来解决这一互操作性问题，并通过Web安全案例研究展示了其可行性。该流水线将Trivy、Semgrep和Nmap的扫描结果解析为MulVAL谓词，并利用LLM辅助过程构建领域特定的Datalog规则，将扫描器可检测的证据与攻击技术相关联。随后，MulVAL/XSB执行符号推理以生成结构化的攻击路径。我们在智能体流水线（混合推理器）中，基于CyBench的54个Web夺旗（CTF）任务对攻击图构建基础设施进行了评估；我们未对……的性能进行评估
tldr: 该论文提出一种半自动化流水线，将Trivy、Semgrep和Nmap的扫描结果解析为MulVAL谓词，并借助LLM辅助构建领域特定的Datalog规则，实现符号化攻击图的自动生成，从而为智能体渗透测试提供显式且可审计的攻击路径推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a semi-automated pipeline that parses findings from Trivy, Semgrep, and Nmap into MulVAL predicates and uses LLM-assisted construction of domain-specific Datalog rules to automatically generate symbolic attack graphs, enabling explicit and auditable attack path reasoning for agentic pentesting.
